title: OmniTensor control reply version 1
description: One reply frame on the control socket, correlated to its request by id. Exactly one of result and error is present. An error here means the method never ran — the frame did not validate, the method does not exist, the dispatch broke, or the guard refused the call at the boundary and its stable code is the error code — while a method that ran answers with a result, even when that answer is a rejection its own schema describes.

version.description: Version of the envelope, not of any method's body.

id.description: The request's id, echoed verbatim; 0 when the request was too broken to carry one.

result.description: The method's reply document, exactly as its own wire schema defines it.

error.description: Why the envelope could not be answered.

code.description: Stable machine-readable cause a client can branch on.
